post.description:
Stop a running stream.

R2-P1-01: the registry hit is checked and logged; ``abort=True`` means
the in-flight stream was found, its abort event set AND its upstream
consumer task cancelled (core's HTTP stream closed at once). The
registry is per-instance: multi-instance deployments must sticky-route
stop requests by message_id (the conditional DB terminal write below
stays correct regardless).

schema.title: Response Stop Message Api V1 Messages  Message Id  Stop Post
Response Ping Internal V1 Ping Get

get.description:
Return 200 only when DB is configured, reachable, migrated and seeded.

Uses its own short-lived connection (NullPool) so readiness never
depends on or pollutes the shared engine pool. R-06: a missing or empty
DSN is HTTP 503 with the fixed body shape (never FastAPI's default 200).

503.description: Not ready: DSN missing/malformed/unreachable, schema behind head, or seed missing
